entries.title: Side-by-side conflict notes in thread summaries
entries.summary: When two people in a support thread state different facts before checking the audit log, the margin now links both messages together instead of picking the latest one silently.

entries.title: Keyboard navigation for source chip popovers
entries.summary: Pressing Enter on any source chip opens the quoted input line and scrolls the input pane into view; pressing Escape returns focus directly to the chip you opened.

entries.title: Daylight-saving offset in March and October timestamps
entries.summary: Fixed a bug where audit log dates near the daylight-saving switch shifted by one hour when comparing messages across European and US timezones.

entries.title: Zero-day stateless run mode for Team and Business
entries.summary: Workspace admins can now set storage retention to 0 days so notebook outputs are streamed to the browser and downloadable as Markdown without touching disk storage.

entries.title: Ambiguous vendor rows flagged in spreadsheet cleanup
entries.summary: Spreadsheet runs now separate clean rows from rows with missing tax receipts or duplicate dates, placing uncertain rows in a red-pencil review group.

entries.title: Firefox CSV export button when filenames contain spaces
entries.summary: Quoted Content-Disposition headers properly so downloading cleaned expense tables on Firefox no longer truncates filenames after the first space.

entries.title: Right-to-left notebook layout and Japanese line breaking
entries.summary: Mirrored the margin rule, step drawer, and curved arrows for Arabic workspaces, and tuned character streaming cadence for Japanese text.
